accepted.sentence: At a vehicle service bay, a hand tool secures license plates to their mounting points during replacement.
When mounting a wall mailbox, installers turn fasteners into the supporting surface to hold its bracket firmly in place.
Ski technicians use a hand tool to attach bindings to skis, following the specified placement and fastening pattern.
During heating-system maintenance, workers remove fasteners from duct access panels before inspecting equipment inside.
Installers attach a smoke detector's mounting plate to the ceiling with fasteners before fitting the alarm unit.
At a picture-framing bench, a hand tool secures hanging hardware to the back of a frame.
When fitting a doorbell button, workers may tighten its small mounting fasteners against the exterior wall.
On a farm, a hand tool can tighten the fasteners that hold a gate latch to its wooden frame.
